answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 41 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The nectar register is checked at draw time, zephyr lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 41 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 300 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
